description: Check whether a single domain name is free to register or already taken, and return AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE or UNDETERMINED exactly as the Domain Availability API reports it (1 credit per lookup). UNDETERMINED means the check could not decide, for example after a transient error or for an unsupported TLD. Use this to screen a name you are considering; the default is the fastest check and the other mode is slower and more accurate. Do NOT use it for many domains at once (use `bulk_domain_availability`) or to find out who owns a domain.

credits.description: Which credit balance the lookup is billed to. The default uses the Domain Availability balance; the other value uses the separate registration-data balance.

mode.description: Depth of the check. The default (when omitted) is the fastest check; the other value is slower and more accurate.

name: domain_availability
